title: Operational signal matrix for per-route embeddings & rerank telemetry
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a reproducible, low-cost observability surface for embeddings + rerank endpoints scoped to individual API routes. Outcome should enable engineers, PMs, and SREs to debug quality regressions, identify cost hotspots per route, and detect latency regressions with traceable request context. This ticket covers instrumentation, metric schema, dashboard templates, cost-attribution queries, SLOs, and alerting playbook for an initial pilot (5 high-traffic routes). Non-goals: changing serving runtime or reranker scoring logic (those are follow-ups once signals identify actionable regressions).
acceptance_criteria: Per-route dashboard template available in Console with latency P50/P95/P99, qps, error_rate, average tokens per request, embedding vector size, and sample quality score
Tracing: end-to-end request_id propagated through API -> router -> rerank worker -> scoring backend; spans include route_id tag and model_variant metadata
Cost breakdown: BigQuery view + Console card that attributes GPU-ms and tokenized-cost per route (per 1000 requests), with confidence bands
Alerts: SLO-based alerts for route P95 latency overshoot and quality-drop alert tied to periodic eval set (daily), with automatic incident link creation
Runbook: onboarding steps and triage playbook for detected regressions, including rollback instructions and fallback route mapping
tasks: Add route_id tag to request context and ensure propagation in current tracing headers
Emit structured metrics from rerank worker: tokens_in, tokens_out, kv_cache_hit, scoring_time_ms, embed_vector_dim
Create BigQuery cost attribution view joining per-request traces with billing exports
Design and publish dashboard templates (Console) and a short guide for PM/Support
Author alert rules and test via synthetic traffic for pilot routes
Pilot on 5 routes, collect 2 weeks of signals, iterate on thresholds
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with PM/Design/SRE. Agreed pilot routes (search-web, internal-help, enterprise-qna, examples-widget, signup-assist).
2026-02-20: Instrumentation spike completed. route_id now injected at API gateway and propagated through grpc metadata. Small PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls/1427
2026-02-24: Decision: use 5% full-span trace sampling for rerank workers to limit egress/storage costs; retain aggregated metrics at 100%.

2026-02-28: Cost attribution prototype query (BQ) run against one day of traces; results show heavy tail: 12% of routes consume 48% of GPU-ms. Link: bigquery.cloud/project:redwood-prod:datasets:rerank_cost_view
2026-03-02: Design review feedback (Elena Kwan): add an explicit per-route customer_affected flag and a visualization for cost-per-1k-requests. Will add to dashboard templates.
2026-03-05: SRE (Marcus Li) requested a trace-replay guard to avoid reprocessing large trace blobs during incident postmortems; added as follow-up task.
notes: Trade-offs: full-span traces are expensive; chosen approach balances signal fidelity and cost by combining 100% aggregated metrics + sampled traces.
We will use a rolling 14-day retention for per-route detailed metrics and keep 90-day aggregated summaries for cost reporting.
If pilot identifies frequent quality regressions, follow-up tickets will target model-variant rollouts and per-route caching strategies.
